sections.brief: The thesis and the test; Iran's bomb warnings (2012 UN speech, Mossad memo) against US assessments (2007 NIE, Gabbard 2025); the threat in the April 2024 supplemental and aid totals; whether each Lebanese war ended the threat (1982 to 2026). Figures: time; compare

Groups Israel itself armed or paid: the SLA and Khiam, the 2013-18 Syrian rebel programme (Foreign Policy, Eisenkot), Gaza militias 2024-26 (UN memo, Netanyahu's June 2025 confirmation, Abu Shabab, ACLED); what the cases show and do not show. Figure: compare

Who gains: Israeli spending and exports, US aid and co-production; Netanyahu's incentives and the 2024 truce he signed over Ben-Gvir's objection; the counter-case (Hezbollah and Houthi attacks, Iran's aims, ceasefires, US restraint); two readings. Figures: money; compare (what the record supports / does not)
